row.Title: Choose the right filament - 3D Filaments Guide for QIDI Printers - QIDI CA Store
row.Source note: Bounded exact-product print-guidance search. Retrieved original bytes preserved separately from earlier revisions. Context from neighbouring products is excluded. Review by Codex AI agent. Consulted for the existing product recipe; no new numeric or affirmative gate fact accepted.

row.Composition / filler: Long-chain polyamide 612 based with 15% chopped carbon fiber reinforced FDM filament. (p. 1, as the sheet states it)
row.Colour caveat: Properties may vary by colour; use TDS scope
row.Selected-grade rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence
row.Diameter compatibility: Check 1.75 mm variant; diameter is not part tolerance

review.note: Existing exact GradeID G059-02 and manufacturer/product; no new grade, shared formulation or identity is inferred.

row.H2C left: Verify exact grade/nozzle; no blanket approval
row.H2C right: Verify exact grade/nozzle; no blanket approval
